fb_text:
"It's all in my head."

Every owner says that. Until the day it isn't.

And it's true — right up until you're sick for a week, or finally take a real vacation, or hire your first guy. Then you find out your head isn't a filing system. It's a single point of failure, and it retires when you do.

FieldNotes doesn't add a new habit. Your crew keeps texting job notes like they always have — and every note goes into one place anyone can ask. "What's the gate code for Riverside?" It answers. From your own notes.

Tried software before and nobody used it? There's no app, no login, no training. It's the texting habit they already have.

I built it for my own business — commercial plant service, 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — because my phone was the office. It isn't anymore.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card — start with the 60-second demo:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
